text: An Android app for our 200 delivery drivers. A driver sees today's route, marks each stop delivered or failed with a photo, and captures a signature. It has to keep working with no signal in basements and sync when the phone reconnects. Push notification when a new job is assigned. Dispatchers watch the same jobs on a web board. Google Maps for navigation, Twilio for the customer SMS. 99.9% uptime, 5,000 deliveries a day. Roughly $120k over six months, and success is 20% fewer late deliveries.
notes: The least certain domain label in the set: Mobile fits the driver app, Logistics or Internal Tool fits the dispatch board, and both are honest readings. Decide which one counts before this becomes ground truth.
